crossRefs.note: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
“Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day…
He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that…

translations.web: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
translations.bsb: So the prophet said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” Then they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it
translations.kjv: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
translations.asv: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass; and he rode thereon.
